Quick technical note: Coupa treats certain mailbox types (distribution lists, role-based aliases) as not eligible for creating user accounts because there's no deterministic owner for verification. We can add the group to an allowlist via tenant config, but that bypasses an automated check and may require an auditor note. It is reversible but will appear in the audit log as a manual override.

Operationally: resend to julia.ramos@atlaspaper.com is zero-risk and will take <5 minutes. If AtlasPaper insists on the group address, we can schedule the whitelist change but expect a 24–48 hour approval window (security review + audit note).

Marissa — please confirm which path you want. Julia — if you reply with the personal address I will coordinate and confirm once the new invite is issued.

Thanks,
